## Rationale

The user chose this. The journal is mostly read when resuming, and what is still open is what decides the next move; history follows below a separator.

## Counter-argument

A single timeline keeps cause and effect next to each other, and the open items are already in Needs you.

payload.choice: Open items first (open questions, findings that need a human, observations with no finding), then every other item newest first
